title: Can pretrained Transformers deliver semiparametrically efficient inference?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semiparametric models provide a broad framework for statistical inference, yet efficient estimation typically relies on influence function correction tailored to each estimand and on nuisance estimation repeated for every sample. We show that a single pretrained Transformer can deliver efficient estimation and valid inference for a family of estimands in one forward pass, without deriving efficient influence functions or estimating nuisance functions. Pretrained on simulated data with the true parameter as the only label, the Transformer learns the posterior mean and covariance of the queried estimand and hence returns an estimate and a Wald-type confidence region. Theoretically, we prove that, for locally flat pretraining priors of slowly growing complexity, the posterior mean is efficient for every queried estimand. The Transformer inherits this efficiency with asymptotically exact coverage, in probability over evaluation populations

translated_title: 预训练Transformer能否实现半参数有效推断？
translated_abstract: 半参数模型为统计推断提供了一个广泛的框架，然而有效估计通常依赖于针对每个待估量量身定制的影响函数校正，以及对每个样本重复进行的干扰函数估计。我们证明，单个预训练Transformer可以在一次前向传播中为一系列待估量提供有效估计和有效推断，而无需推导有效影响函数或估计干扰函数。通过在以真实参数作为唯一标签的模拟数据上进行预训练，该Transformer学习所查询待估量的后验均值和协方差，从而返回一个估计值和一个Wald型置信区域。理论上，我们证明，对于复杂度缓慢增长的局部平坦预训练先验，后验均值对每个查询的待估量都是有效的。该Transformer继承了这种有效性，并具有渐近精确的覆盖率，在评估总体上以概率成立。
tldr: 该论文证明单个预训练Transformer无需推导有效影响函数或估计干扰函数，即可通过一次前向传播对一族半参数待估量同时实现有效估计与具有渐近精确覆盖率的有效推断。
en_tdlr: A single pretrained Transformer can deliver semiparametrically efficient estimation and valid inference with asymptotically exact coverage for a family of estimands in one forward pass, without deriving efficient influence functions or estimating nuisance functions.
